About us

Premium Drones Georgia: XAG agricultural drones, field spraying, training and service, from Lagodekhi.

From the field, not from an office.

Since 2022 we have been bringing XAG agricultural drones to Georgian farms. We sell the equipment, treat fields, train operators and service the drones.

PDG trained at XAG’s centre in China. In season we work in the field ourselves, so we know what a farmer needs: reliable equipment, parts close by and fast help.

Founder and CEOAleko Tchumburidze
